Metadata.Title: Middle-earth: Shadow of Mordor - Game of the Year Edition
Metadata.Name: 120 FPS
Metadata.Note: Runs the game above 60 fps, up to 120 fps depending on the scene and resolution. The manager turns on the 120 Hz video output when you enable it, and your TV or monitor must accept 120 Hz. Works alone or with any resolution entry. Based on the 60 FPS patch by Jao. Only one frame rate entry can be on at a time.
Metadata.Author: Jao
